reasoning: On the season so far the Thunder are the stronger team; with home court the Thunder start about 9 points better, in a game of about 225 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Thunder.
The mental side leans about 0 points towards the Bucks.
Bottom line: the Thunder win 79 times in 100, by about 10; most games like this end between 198 and 246 total points.

analyst.text: Oklahoma City arrive on a three-game losing streak (seven losses in nine) and are missing Chet Holmgren (patellar tendon, around New Year), Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander called the slide 'motivation' and says he must be more aggressive early. Milwaukee are 2-17. A team with a point to prove against the league's worst record leans Oklahoma City.
